name: Production Measurement
job: Automatically resume or open the next unposted planned week, compare expected usage with used-or-left measurements, and post reviewed stock movement.
incomingHandoff: Planning has already chosen the meals and quantities, and a worker opens Production after a cook.
outgoingHandoff: The reviewed production draft posts ingredient consumption and finished meal output only after explicit confirmation.
responsiveBehaviour: Keep expected, available, measurement method, actual quantity, and unit together; recompose every ingredient as a labelled mobile record.

layoutContract.containment: A compact page header and numbered workflow guide precede plan selection and measurement work; draft save, review, and final posting remain separate actions.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Content padding does not define primitive bounds.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted until its semantic owner and edge behavior are chosen.

motionContract.justification: Variance and posting status are expressed numerically and textually, not through motion.
